topics.label: Course Introduction and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation in the context of the broader course.

topics.label: Pathogen- and Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define PAMPs and DAMPs and describe the criteria that make molecular patterns effective indicators of infection or cellular injury.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptors and Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular pattern recognition receptor families, their subcellular locations, and the signaling pathways that activate immune responses.

topics.label: Leukocyte Trafficking and Acute Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how acute inflammation directs immune cell trafficking into and out of tissues and describe the systemic risks of excessive activation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation and Tissue Healing
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how tissues resolve acute inflammation, repair cellular damage, and adapt to persistent inflammatory challenges.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the topic of the next lecture.
